scripts.start: npm run setup && npm run infra:up && npm run app
scripts.start:quick: npm run infra:up && npm run app
scripts.setup: npm ci --include=dev && npm run setup:python && npm run setup:config && npm run setup:browsers && npm run build:ui
scripts.setup:browsers: uv run --no-sync python -m playwright install chromium && uv run --no-sync python -c "from applypilot.onboarding.browser_runtime import prepare; prepare()"
scripts.litellm:build: docker compose -p guides --env-file docs/guides/.env -f docs/guides/docker-compose.litellm.yml build litellm
scripts.litellm:up: npm run litellm:build && docker compose -p guides --env-file docs/guides/.env -f docs/guides/docker-compose.litellm.yml up -d --wait --wait-timeout 300
scripts.litellm:stop: docker compose -p guides --env-file docs/guides/.env -f docs/guides/docker-compose.litellm.yml stop
scripts.litellm:logs: docker compose -p guides --env-file docs/guides/.env -f docs/guides/docker-compose.litellm.yml logs --tail 100 -f litellm
scripts.temporal:build: docker compose -p applypilot-temporal --env-file docs/guides/.env -f docs/guides/docker-compose.temporal.yml build temporal-workflows
scripts.temporal:up: npm run temporal:build && docker compose -p applypilot-temporal --env-file docs/guides/.env -f docs/guides/docker-compose.temporal.yml up -d --wait --wait-timeout 180
scripts.temporal:stop: docker compose -p applypilot-temporal --env-file docs/guides/.env -f docs/guides/docker-compose.temporal.yml stop
scripts.temporal:logs: docker compose -p applypilot-temporal --env-file docs/guides/.env -f docs/guides/docker-compose.temporal.yml logs --tail 100 -f temporal temporal-workflows
scripts.infra:up: npm run litellm:up && npm run temporal:up
scripts.infra:stop: npm run temporal:stop && npm run litellm:stop
scripts.infra:status: docker compose -p guides --env-file docs/guides/.env -f docs/guides/docker-compose.litellm.yml ps && docker compose -p applypilot-temporal --env-file docs/guides/.env -f docs/guides/docker-compose.temporal.yml ps
scripts.app:init: uv run --no-sync python scripts/local_runtime.py temporal initialize
scripts.app:workers: uv run --no-sync python scripts/local_runtime.py temporal worker --roles preparation,discovery,research,models,documents,learning,network,email,social,reporting,maintenance,egress,browser
scripts.app:applications: uv run --no-sync python scripts/local_runtime.py temporal worker --roles applications
scripts.status: npm run infra:status && uv run --no-sync python scripts/local_runtime.py temporal status
scripts.tools:build: docker compose -p guides --env-file docs/guides/.env -f docs/guides/docker-compose.litellm.yml build source-tools egress-region-controller egress-singbox-controller
